checkpoints.check: Loading states are visible for operations >1 second
checkpoints.notes: Basket skeletons exist (basket/page.tsx:128), home spinner (page.tsx:22), but availability verify silent fail no toast (basket/page.tsx:56-60). Checkout verify->paystack redirect has no progress bar.

checkpoints.check: Progress indicators shown for multi-step processes
checkpoints.notes: Search->Basket->Verify->Checkout->Paystack->Complete is 5 steps with no stepper. Breadcrumb only on basket/checkout, no progress bar.

checkpoints.check: Success/error feedback appears after user actions
checkpoints.notes: addToBasket only toast (SearchPageContent.tsx:93), but verify error only console.error, no toast. Paystack init error does toast (checkout/page.tsx:107). Inconsistent.

checkpoints.check: Current location is clear in navigation
checkpoints.notes: Header active states on /search work (SearchPageContent.tsx:128), but mobile nav hamburger (page.tsx:51) does nothing. No nav on /profile.

heuristics.name: Match between system and real world

checkpoints.check: Labels use user language, not internal jargon
checkpoints.notes: Terms 'Basket' (UK) vs 'Cart' inconsistent with Paystack currency NGN (Nigeria). availabilityToken exposed in URL, not user language.

checkpoints.check: Icons follow established conventions
checkpoints.notes: flight/hotel/car icons correct, material-symbols used consistently.

checkpoints.check: Information appears in natural and logical order
checkpoints.notes: Home hero -> categories -> deals flows logically.

checkpoints.check: Metaphors match real-world expectations
checkpoints.notes: Basket, checkout metaphors ok.

checkpoints.check: Undo is available for destructive actions
checkpoints.notes: removeFromBasket immediate, no undo. Bookings cancel/modify has modals (cancellation-modal.tsx, booking-modification-modal.tsx) with confirm.

checkpoints.check: Cancel/back options are clearly visible
checkpoints.notes: Breadcrumbs present but no explicit back on checkout.

checkpoints.check: Users can exit flows without losing progress
checkpoints.notes: Guest basket stored locally (travelease_guest_basket_v1) but not merged on login explicitly shown. Refresh loses availabilityToken (checkout requires it).

checkpoints.check: Confirmation dialogs for irreversible actions
checkpoints.notes: Cancel/delete confirmed via dialogs.

checkpoints.check: UI elements behave the same way throughout
checkpoints.notes: Navbar has 3 variants: page.tsx header, SearchPageContent header, basket nav - padding/gaps/colors differ. Inconsistent.

checkpoints.check: Terminology is consistent across all pages
checkpoints.notes: TravelEase vs VoyageFlow (docs/blueprint.md says VoyageFlow, code says TravelEase). Basket vs Bookings vs My Trips labels drift.

checkpoints.check: Visual patterns (spacing, colors) are consistent
checkpoints.notes: Primaries consistent (#2A6CF5) but rounding 2xl vs xl vs 3xl varies.

checkpoints.check: Platform conventions are followed
checkpoints.notes: Uses Next.js Link, shadcn patterns.

checkpoints.check: Form validation occurs before submission
checkpoints.notes: Checkout form (checkout/page.tsx:194-306) has required but phone/dates/guests not validated; dates input on home (page.tsx:92) is type=text with no date picker, no validation.

checkpoints.check: Constraints prevent invalid inputs
checkpoints.notes: Guests input type=number min=1 but free text on home allows any string. Search price slider allows no results with no guidance.

checkpoints.check: Destructive actions require confirmation
checkpoints.notes: Cancel/delete modals ok.

checkpoints.check: Default values reduce user effort and errors
checkpoints.notes: Checkout guestCount defaults to 1 but should be 2 (common case). Location defaults Santorini regardless of user history.

checkpoints.check: Options are visible rather than requiring memorization
checkpoints.notes: Filters visible in sidebar.

checkpoints.check: Help and instructions are easily accessible
checkpoints.notes: No contextual help, no empty-state guidance beyond 'Start Exploring'. Support page exists but not linked contextually.

checkpoints.check: Recently used items are easily accessible
checkpoints.notes: No recent searches, no wishlist/history.

checkpoints.check: Search and filter options are visible
checkpoints.notes: Filters visible desktop, but hidden on mobile (aside hidden lg:flex).

checkpoints.check: Keyboard shortcuts available for frequent actions
checkpoints.notes: No shortcuts needed for travel booking, low priority.

checkpoints.check: Customizable interface elements
checkpoints.notes: No customization.

checkpoints.check: Shortcuts or recent items for repeat tasks
checkpoints.notes: No one-click rebook, no saved passengers, no favorite hotels.

checkpoints.check: Batch operations for power users
checkpoints.notes: Not applicable.

checkpoints.check: Each screen focuses on one primary action
checkpoints.notes: Checkout page (checkout/page.tsx:181-407) has 5 sections + summary competing; should be progressive disclosure.

checkpoints.check: Visual hierarchy guides attention to important elements
checkpoints.notes: Hierarchy ok on search cards, but checkout CTA competes with many radios.

checkpoints.check: Whitespace used effectively
checkpoints.notes: Spacing generous.

checkpoints.check: No unnecessary decorative elements that distract
checkpoints.notes: Clean.

heuristics.name: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors

checkpoints.check: Error messages are in plain language (no codes)
checkpoints.notes: Availability verify failure shows nothing (console only). Paystack errors bubble raw message but ok.

checkpoints.check: Error messages indicate what went wrong specifically
checkpoints.notes: 401 on /api/bookings/* returns 'Unauthorized' no recovery path shown.

checkpoints.check: Error messages suggest how to fix the issue
checkpoints.notes: Empty search says 'No matches' but no suggestion to reset filters.

checkpoints.check: Errors are visually prominent and close to the source
checkpoints.notes: Toast used inconsistently.

checkpoints.check: Help is easily accessible from any screen
checkpoints.notes: Support link in nav but no contextual help, no onboarding.

checkpoints.check: Contextual help is provided where needed
checkpoints.notes: Fees breakdown no explanation; availabilityToken concept not explained.

checkpoints.check: Onboarding guides new users through key features
checkpoints.notes: No onboarding at all; first-time user dropped to home with no walkthrough.

checkpoints.check: Documentation is searchable and task-focused
checkpoints.notes: Support pages exist (/support/terms, cancellation) but sparse.

checkpoints.check: Text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio (WCAG AA)
checkpoints.notes: Slates on white mostly pass, but primary #2A6CF5 on white 4.1:1 fails AA for small text; badge green/white also low.

checkpoints.check: Large text meets 3:1 contrast ratio
checkpoints.notes: Headings pass.

checkpoints.check: Color is not the only way to convey information
checkpoints.notes: LeftCount red text only color, availability green dot only color.

checkpoints.check: Focus indicators have sufficient contrast
checkpoints.notes: Focus rings rely on browser defaults, not styled; some buttons remove outline via tailwind.

checkpoints.check: All interactive elements reachable via Tab key
checkpoints.notes: Cards Book Now is button but inside div, ok; however slider may not be keyboard accessible correctly.

checkpoints.check: Focus order follows logical reading order
checkpoints.notes: Order logical.

checkpoints.check: Focus ring is visible on all interactive elements
checkpoints.notes: Tailwind focus:ring-0 on search inputs removes ring (page.tsx:83, SearchPageContent:118).

checkpoints.check: No keyboard traps (user can always navigate away)
checkpoints.notes: No traps detected.

checkpoints.check: All images have meaningful alt text
checkpoints.notes: Search cards alt='travel destination' generic; should be title. Picsum placeholders not descriptive.

checkpoints.check: Form inputs have associated labels
checkpoints.notes: Home hero inputs (page.tsx:82-96) have no labels, only placeholders - fails a11y. Checkout labels exist but not htmlFor linked.

checkpoints.check: ARIA attributes used correctly for dynamic content
checkpoints.notes: Toast likely has aria-live but not verified; basket loading not aria-busy.

checkpoints.check: Headings follow logical hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3)
checkpoints.notes: Home has h1 then h2 then h3 ok, but Search has no h1, jumps to h3 Filters.
